title: Functorial derived residue cohomology
statement: For a scheme W, its point w and an integer i, form the functor D(O_W) -> ModuleCat(kappa(w)) by derived pullback along the canonical residue point, degree-i homology, terminal evaluation and restriction of scalars along GammaSpecIso.inv. Its object is derivedFiberCohomology [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti].

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Compose the four actual functors in the definition. Functoriality supplies identities and composition on derived arrows.
